segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making the time. I had us down to talk through the 42-seat proposal and confirm the April 15 go-live target.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that's right. We have 38 users today, and finance approved moving to 42 because the operations team is adding four supervisors next month.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. The quote I sent has 42 standard seats at $68 per seat per month, annual term, so $34,272 before tax. It also includes the one-time implementation package at $4,500.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On implementation, does that cover the two workflow templates we discussed, or is that separate services time?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s included. The package covers configuration, two workflow templates, admin training, and one launch readiness session. If you need additional templates after go-live, that would be scoped separately.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Billing-wise, we need the invoice dated after March 25, because that’s when the new cost center opens.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. We can set the order to start April 1 and have the invoice generated March 26 with net 30 terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Legal had one question on the renewal language. They’re okay with annual renewal, but they want 30 days' notice instead of 60 if we decide not to renew.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, we can accept 30 days' notice. I’ll update that in the order form and send the clean version this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If we sign by Friday, are we still okay for April 15?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If we have signature by March 22, we’ll schedule kickoff the week of March 25 and stay on track for April 15.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send the revised order form, and I’ll route it for signature.
